Pricing

Start free. Upgrade when you watch more.

The panel is free forever. Pro adds an unlimited watchlist and notifications. Cancel any time.

Free

For checking the names you trade.

$0forever
  • Panel on all four platforms
  • Bond-to-issuer mapping
  • Watchlist of 3 tickers
  • Floating signal box: Quiet, Watch or Hot
  • About 20 chart lookups a day, more with a free Bargo key (opens in a new tab)
Add to Chrome
Recommended

Pro

For active traders with a real watchlist.

$8/month
  • Everything in Free
  • Unlimited watchlist
  • Browser notification when a watched ticker gets a new filing or turns Hot
  • Secure checkout via Stripe; cancel any time
Start Free, Upgrade Later

Desk

For newsletters, research teams and desks.

Custom
  • Everything in Pro, per seat
  • Related bills and executive orders by sector (preview)
  • Hosted data service with higher lookup limits
  • Consolidated billing
Join the Desk Waitlist

How paying works

Pro is bought inside the extension popup, through ExtensionPay and Stripe. You do not need a Capitol Tape account to use the extension or to upgrade. The optional account on this site is separate.

Not financial advice. Capitol Tape displays publicly available U.S. congressional stock trade disclosures (STOCK Act data) for information only. It is not financial, investment or trading advice, and nothing on this site or in the extension is a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Disclosures may be delayed up to 45 days after a trade and may be incomplete or wrong; verify with the official House and Senate filings. See Data & Disclaimers.

Capitol Tape is not affiliated with or endorsed by TradingView, Robinhood, Webull, Charles Schwab, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Fidelity, E*TRADE, Vanguard, Public, Bargo, Google, GitHub, Mozilla, the U.S. Congress or any government entity. All trademarks belong to their owners.
